items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] : This was like before Red Norvo and those guys?

ctx.x: Out of this world. Out of this world.
: This was like before Red Norvo and those guys?
Oh, Red, no, ain't nobody ever heard of Hamp. Hamp was playing in California at Sebastian's Cotton Club. Louis was on trumpet, Hamp was playing drums, playing drums --
